name: Omnara
cost: Free to self-host (Apache 2.0). Omnara Cloud has no platform fee: free with your own keys and machines, or pay as you go for its models and sandboxes
works_with: Any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible model, macOS and Linux machines, many sandbox providers, Slack, Discord, GitHub, and MCP clients
short: An open-source platform for running AI agents as a service on any model and any machine. Self-host it or use Omnara Cloud.
what: Omnara runs AI agents for you through one API. Each agent has a model, tools, secrets and machines where it runs commands, and every step is saved so it can pick up after a crash. You launch agents from the CLI, a TypeScript SDK, Slack, Discord, GitHub or a schedule, and you can make each tool ask a person before it runs.
who: Developers and teams who want hosted agents without being tied to one model company, or who want agent history in their own database. Skip it if you only need one coding agent in your own terminal.
needs: Node.js 22 or newer for the CLI
For Omnara Cloud: an account at app.omnara.com
For self-hosting: Docker with Compose, plus a model provider and a machine you connect
For the TypeScript SDK: an API key exported as `OMNARA_TOKEN`

steps.title: Sign in to Omnara Cloud
steps.text: Sign in at app.omnara.com. Your first project comes with a model provider and a pool of sandboxes.

steps.title: Write the agent config
steps.code:
version: v1
instruction: |
  You are an engineering assistant. Use your machine to run commands.
model:
  provider_config: omnara-openrouter
  name: anthropic/claude-fable-5.1
machine_sources:
  - machine_pool_name: default-pool

steps.title: Launch it
steps.text: If you're not logged in, this opens your browser to sign in. Then chat with `npx omnara agents chat <agent-id>` or watch it in the dashboard.
steps.code:
npx omnara agents launch --file agent.yaml \
  --name "Machine assistant" \
  --message "Report this machine's operating system and free disk space."

steps.title: Or self-host it
steps.text: Then open `http://localhost:8000` and sign up. Add a model provider and a model, connect a machine and share both with your project.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/omnara-ai/omnara.git
cd omnara
docker compose -f compose.yaml --profile app up -d

steps.title: Point the CLI at your own instance
steps.text: In `agent.yaml`, use your own provider and model names and replace the `machine_pool_name` entry with `machine_name: <your machine>`.
steps.code:
npx omnara config --api-url http://localhost:8000/api/v1 --issuer-url http://localhost:8000
npx omnara login

try.label: From the README
try.text: Help me set up Omnara by following https://www.omnara.com/SKILL.md

watch: Agents run shell commands and edit files on the machines you connect. Each tool can run straight away, ask a person first or be blocked.
The local self-host defaults are intentionally insecure. Follow the self-hosting guide before any real deployment.
On Omnara Cloud, agent history is stored by Omnara. Self-hosted, it stays in your own Postgres.
Sandboxes on a self-hosted instance only work once it has a public URL.
The setup prompt has your agent follow a SKILL.md from omnara.com. Read it before you hand it over.
